title: In from the Rain  (Entrando de la lluvia)

segments.t: Abajo en el vestíbulo, Caleb, un viajero tranquilo de unos treinta y pocos años, entra sacudiendo su paraguas mojado. Hannah lo recibe en el mostrador mientras Tessa le acerca una toalla seca. Escuchemos primero.
Good evening! Come inside out of the rain, sir.
Good evening. Sorry for dripping water on your clean floor.
Do not worry at all! You must be Caleb.
Yes, Caleb. I booked room seven by phone yesterday.
Here is a dry towel for your coat and a cup of hot soup, sir.
Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.
Sir, before we go upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.
Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?
We accidentally booked two guests into room seven tonight.
Ah... in this rain? Every hotel near the station looked full.
Please do not worry! We prepared our quiet third floor attic study just for you.
An attic study? May I see it first?
Vamos a repasar el diálogo frase por frase.
Good evening! Come inside out of the rain, sir.
'¡Buenas noches! Pase adentro y resguárdese de la lluvia, señor.'
Good evening. Sorry for dripping water on your clean floor.
'Buenas noches. Perdón por gotear agua sobre su suelo limpio.'
Do not worry at all! You must be Caleb.
'¡No se preocupe en absoluto! Usted debe de ser Caleb.'
Yes, Caleb. I booked room seven by phone yesterday.
'Sí, Caleb. Reservé la habitación siete por teléfono ayer.'
Here is a dry towel for your coat and a cup of hot soup, sir.
'Aquí tiene una toalla seca para su abrigo y una taza de sopa caliente, señor.'
Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.
'¿Sopa caliente? Después de ese paseo frío bajo la lluvia, eso suena de maravilla.'
Sir, before we go upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.
'Señor, antes de subir, le debo una disculpa sincera.'
Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?
'¿Ah, sí? ¿Hay algún problema con mi reserva?'
We accidentally booked two guests into room seven tonight.
'Por accidente registramos a dos huéspedes en la habitación siete esta noche.'
Ah... in this rain? Every hotel near the station looked full.
'Ah... ¿con esta lluvia? Todos los hoteles cerca de la estación parecían llenos.'
Please do not worry! We prepared our quiet third floor attic study just for you.
'¡Por favor, no se preocupe! Preparamos nuestro tranquilo estudio del ático del tercer piso solo para usted.'
An attic study? May I see it first?
'¿Un estudio en el ático? ¿Puedo verlo primero?'
Escuchemos otra vez toda la escena a ritmo normal.
Good evening! Come inside out of the rain, sir.
Good evening. Sorry for dripping water on your clean floor.
Do not worry at all! You must be Caleb.
Yes, Caleb. I booked room seven by phone yesterday.
Here is a dry towel for your coat and a cup of hot soup, sir.
Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.
Sir, before we go upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.
Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?
We accidentally booked two guests into room seven tonight.
Ah... in this rain? Every hotel near the station looked full.
Please do not worry! We prepared our quiet third floor attic study just for you.
An attic study? May I see it first?
La sinceridad, una toalla seca y una taza de sopa caliente mantuvieron la conversación serena. En la próxima escena, Caleb sube la escalera para juzgar el ático por sí mismo. Hasta la próxima.
See you soon!
